hxtabs.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Tabs API.

A tab widget is a collection of buttons controlling an area below the buttons. A common use of this widget is to associate a child container with each button, with a container made visible in response to a button-down on its parent.

uint32_t  tabID,
HxContainer_t *  pContainer,
const char *  pText 
)

Add a tab to a tab widget.

HxTabsAddTab adds a new tab and its container to a tab widget.

Parameters:
pTabs IN: Pointer to a tab widget
tabID IN: ID to identify the tab
pContainer IN: pointer to container to associated with tab, or NULL if no association.
pText IN: Null-terminated string
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if a memory error occurs.

HxResult HxTabsDelete ( HxTabs_t *  pTabs  ) 

Delete a tab widget.

HxTabsDelete deletes a tab widget created from an earlier call to HxTabsNew.

The application is responsible for deleting containers associated with the tab widget by calls to HxTabsAddTab.

Parameters:
pTabs IN: Pointer to the tab widget
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxTabsNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
HxTabs_t **  hTabs 
)

Create a tab widget.

HxTabsNew creates a tab widget.

The pBounds argument does not include the area needed by the tab buttons. The system allocates space above pBounds for the tab buttons.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to parent widget
pBounds IN: Pointer to rectangle describing the position and size of the control
hTabs OUT: Handle to the created tab widget, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
